A1.justification: Both PDFs describe EffoVPR and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–F. Corresponding material can be matched despite reformatting and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original zero-shot and fine-tuned VPR experiments, benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative matching examples.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments and adds threshold and resolution sensitivity results, timing measurements, and BoQ evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix E retain the DINOv2 backbone, CLS/CosFace training, attention-filtered Value descriptors, and mutual-nearest-neighbor reranking. The revised keypoint detector/descriptor terminology explains the existing procedure.

E1.justification: SF-XL training and the same 20 VPR evaluation scenarios are retained. The new sensitivity experiments use existing Tokyo24/7 and MSLS-val data rather than extending dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: BoQ is added to the comparisons in Tables 2–4 and v2 Table S8, corresponding to v1 Table S6. Previous comparators remain, including DINOv2 and AnyLoc in the zero-shot comparison.

E3.justification: New experiments vary T1 over 0.00/0.05/0.10, T2 over 0.50/0.65/0.80, and inference resolution over 224/322/504 pixels. Figure S1 also adds a seven-layer fine-tuning condition. Existing benchmark splits, metrics, training schedule, and default settings are retained.

E4.justification: Appendix B adds targeted threshold-value sensitivity studies and a resolution analysis with timing measurements. The trainable-layer ablation gains a seven-layer condition. Existing threshold-presence, feature-facet, extraction-layer, candidate-count, and qualitative analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The additional timing averages do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: v2 adds BoQ scores and sensitivity/timing results while retaining EffoVPR's headline benchmark scores. Table 2 changes CosPlace's Pitts30k R@1 from 90.5 to 88.4, matching Table 3. New Table S7 reports Tokyo24/7 R@1 of 98.4/98.4/98.7 at 224/322/504 pixels.

T1.justification: The attention and mutual-nearest-neighbor constructions retain their meaning. Changes to layer indices, token-count dimensions, and NN argument ordering are notation corrections consistent with the existing description; no substantive assumptions, derivations, or proofs change.

C1.justification: Both versions claim effective zero-shot reranking, compact CLS-based descriptors down to 128D without external pooling, and strong VPR generalization. v2's emphasis on keypoint matching and few-candidate reranking restates capabilities already presented in v1.

C2.justification: v2 adds interpretation of resolution, patch count, and computational trade-offs. It removes the concluding discussion of foregoing geometric verification for speed and its potential future benefit. The cable-car failure case and panorama-training constraint remain elsewhere.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly discloses validation-based threshold selection and A100 forward-pass timings of 13.82 ms at 224 pixels and 28.8 ms at 504 pixels. Appendix E.1.2 explains the use of released BoQ weights. The existing implementation recipe remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds BoQ and literature on self-supervised ViT properties, semantic correspondence, and appearance transfer, including Park, Shtedritski, Tumanyan, and Zhang works. These provide a focused extension of the local-feature positioning while preserving the central comparison with existing VPR approaches.

P1.justification: The introduction is reorganized around topical headings, related work is reordered and expanded, and method explanations emphasize detector/descriptor roles. A main-text ablation summary is added and the conclusion is rewritten. Together these constitute substantial narrative restructuring.

P2.justification: v2 adopts ICLR formatting, redraws Figure 3a with separate scales, converts v1 Table S5 into Figure S1, and adds three sensitivity tables and BoQ rows. Most illustrations and existing table structures are retained; the extended benchmark table is renumbered S6 to S8.

improvement.justification: The BoQ comparisons, threshold sensitivity tests, resolution controls, and timing disclosures modestly strengthen evaluation and transparency without changing the central findings. These gains outweigh the limited loss of the geometric-verification caveat; the concrete zero-shot failure discussion remains.
